status: Verified focused SQL-client transport repair; independent Sheilun acquisition implementation remains OPEN and unpromoted.
cause: A native SQL error can terminate mysql/mariadb while WriteAsync or FlushAsync still writes a larger input file. The old helper propagated the resulting IOException instead of completing both output-copy tasks and returning the native failing exit. The SQL error remained in the captured stderr but callers received a broken-pipe exception.
repair: Always close stdin, wait for the owned SQL client and drain both stdout/stderr before interpreting input failure. An IOException paired with a nonzero child exit returns that actual failing scalar exit. A successful child paired with an input failure, or a non-IO input failure, remains a visible exception. Native SQL errors are never suppressed or converted into success.
